title: [Feature] Add ETP support for Qwen4Exp PLE embedding table sharding
body:
## What this PR does / why we need it?

  Backport of #20276 to the v0.32.0rc release lane.

  Added Engram Tensor Parallel (ETP) support for the Qwen4Exp PLE embedding
  table, so the table can be sharded across cards and TP can be reduced to
  fit DP+TP deployment shapes.

  ### Key changes
  - ETP group construction (`parallel_state.py`): initialize ETP as alias of
    TP group during `init_ascend_model_parallel`.
  - Platform validation (`platform.py`): preserve engram config for Qwen4Exp
    and keep ETP=TP without THP.
  - Tests: lock the Ascend EDP member-order invariant.
  - Guard: skip ETP rebuild when engram_config lacks get_parallel_size.

  ## Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?
  Yes. Qwen4Exp PLE embedding tables can now be sharded across TP ranks via ETP.

  ## How was this patch tested?
  - Unit tests: tests/ut/models/test_engram.py
  - Real-hardware A3: 4 scenarios (TP=8, DP+EP) all passed.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
